prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1402; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in League City, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact pushed me forward and then back against my seat. I got out and spoke with the other driver, and I have described what happened the same way every time since then, whether to the other party, to the adjuster, or to the medical staff who examined me. I am the named insured on the policy that covers the vehicle I was driving. Within a day I began experiencing stiffness in my neck and pain that radiated into my upper back, and a doctor diagnosed whiplash. I am still attending physical therapy and am filing this claim to cover the medical care and the repairs to my car.
